summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for resolving optional Scala standard library module imports. It differs semantically and structurally from existing micro_skills (codec derivation, JSON parsing) and peer knowledge_references. The peer_candidates are complementary (lookup reference and automatic scope reference) but do not subsume this executable workflow. No existing skill covers the procedural steps of identifying functional requirements, mapping to modules, declaring imports, and ensuring JAR availability.
